item.title: Sheriff's office says stay away from northern St. Joseph County, Michigan Friday
item.description: ST. JOSEPH COUNTY, Mich. -- The St. Joseph County Michigan Sheriff's Office is asking residents to avoid the north end of the county until further notice as emergency personnel respond to widespread damage from Friday's tornado.

item.title: EPD identifies patrolmen from fatal Feb. 8 officer-involved shooting
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. -- The Elkhart Police Department has identified the two patrolmen in the fatal officer-involved shooting which occurred on Feb. 8 at High Dive Park.

item.title: WATCH: Bird's eye view of destructive tornado aftermath at Three Rivers Menards
item.description: THREE RIVERS, Mich. -- ABC57 was live in the sky with a bird's eye view of the destructive aftermath of Friday afternoon tornado which blew the roof off a Menards and storage sheds.

item.title: Notre Dame faces must-win finale at Boston College to keep ACC tournament hopes alive
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- The regular season comes down to one final game for the Notre Dame men’s basketball team. The scenario is simple: Notre Dame must defeat Boston College and Syracuse must beat Pittsburgh. If both results happen, the Irish will qualify for the conference tournament. A Notre Dame loss would end the season and mark the first time the program has missed the ACC Tournament

item.title: Michigan City man sentenced for unlawful possession of a firearm after feeing traffic stop
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- On Tuesday, 29-year-old Dontia Grant of Michigan City was sentenced by United States District Court Judge Cristal C. Brisco to 66 months in prison followed by two years of supervised release after pleading guilty to being a convicted felon in possession of a firearm.

item.title: I&M working to restore power in southwest Michigan after severe storm
item.description: ST. JOSEPH COUNTY, Mich. -- Late Friday afternoon, severe weather and strong winds moved through northern Indiana and southwest Michigan, affecting portions of Indiana Michigan Power's (I&M) territory.

item.title: Cass County declares local state of emergency, one person dead following storm
item.description: CASS COUNTY, Mich. -- After severe weather throughout Friday afternoon and evening, Cass County has declared a local state of emergency.
